item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-5e9aa9a50edaa5e6","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"In August 2023, the first two volumes of Xi Jinping's selected works were translated into Mongolian, Tibetan, Uygur, Kazak, Korean, Yi, and Zhuang, then published and distributed nationwide to support study of Xi Jinping Thought among ethnic minority groups.","question_ids":["4B.5","8B.1","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023 publication and distribution; the volumes contain works from 2012-2022.","ruler_attribution":"The official statement presents the publication as implementing and disseminating Xi Jinping Thought.","limitations":["Official state-media account; no independent evidence of readership, uptake, or effects on minority political rights."]},{"source_id":"SRC-291b16bf01616500","start_unit":1,"end_unit":1,"fact_summary":"In April 2023, the Party Literature Editing Committee published and ordered nationwide distribution of the first two volumes of Xi Jinping's selected works, containing 146 speeches, instructions, and directives from November 2012 to October 2022; the statement described them as an authoritative resource for the Party and nation.","question_ids":["4B.5","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Publication occurred in 2023, while the compiled material covers 2012-2022.","ruler_attribution":"The source identifies Xi as the principal founder of Xi Jinping Thought and frames the books as a Party-wide implementation resource.","limitations":["Official Xinhua account; it documents dissemination and institutional endorsement, not independent implementation or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e0478fbba44676c4","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"In September 2023, a traditional-Chinese thread-bound edition of the first two volumes of Xi Jinping's selected works was published as a study and collection edition, extending publication of works from November 2012 to October 2022.","question_ids":["4B.5","8B.1","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Publication occurred in 2023; the edition covers earlier works.","ruler_attribution":"The publication is explicitly devoted to Xi's works and presents them as authoritative political texts.","limitations":["Official Xinhua/People's Daily account; no evidence of practical policy effects or independent reception."]},{"source_id":"SRC-58047fe6694d8fe7","start_unit":2,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"In June-August 2023, the Cyberspace Administration launched a two-month nationwide campaign to protect minors online, targeting harmful and disguised sexual, violent, bullying, exploitative, fraudulent, addictive, and AI-generated content; it required platforms to inspect and rectify services and authorized severe measures including account bans, blacklisting, delisting, and closure.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","4B.9","6B.6","6B.8","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The campaign was announced and implemented during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The central cyberspace authority issued the directives to provincial authorities and platforms under the central government system.","limitations":["The document states directives and enforcement powers but provides no completion data, case totals, or independent assessment of effectiveness."]},{"source_id":"SRC-bc2e73987fcc08b5","start_unit":1,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"On April 6, 2023, Xi said China would pursue talks and a political solution to the Ukraine crisis and proposed with France that parties maintain restraint, avoid escalation, observe international humanitarian law, protect civilians and children, reject nuclear and biological weapons use, avoid attacks on civilian nuclear facilities, resume peace talks, and address spillover effects.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.5","1B.8","2B.1","2B.4","2B.7","2B.10","8B.1","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Statement made in April 2023 and directly concerns the 2023 Ukraine crisis.","ruler_attribution":"The statement attributes the proposed diplomatic position directly to Xi Jinping.","limitations":["It records rhetoric and a proposed joint appeal, not verified implementation, leverage over combatants, or durable settlement."]},{"source_id":"SRC-fa6f29ed23590c0e","start_unit":3,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Official 2023 education-finance statistics reported total national education expenditure of 64,595.04 billion yuan, up 5.33% year-on-year; state fiscal education expenditure was 50,439.47 billion yuan, up 4.06%, and fiscal education spending equaled 4.00% of GDP.","question_ids":["5B.6","5B.10","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.10","8B.3","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The statistics cover the 2023 fiscal year, although the notice was published in November-December 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The figures were issued by the Ministry of Education, National Bureau of Statistics, and Ministry of Finance within the central government system.","limitations":["National aggregates do not establish equitable incidence, service quality, access, or Xi-specific causation; the data exclude Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan."]},{"source_id":"SRC-24acb72346669e49","start_unit":2,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In January-February 2023, the Cyberspace Administration conducted a one-month Spring Festival campaign against online gambling, fraud, harmful content, bullying, addiction, misinformation, and exploitation of minors; it directed local authorities and platforms to inspect priority channels, establish work teams, strengthen content review, and punish or close violating accounts, platforms, and MCN organizations.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","4B.9","6B.6","6B.8","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The campaign ran during January-February 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The central cyberspace authority initiated the campaign and directed local cyberspace offices and platforms.","limitations":["The notice specifies objectives and enforcement mechanisms but reports no implementation results, case numbers, or independent evaluation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-a70f43292a8224ab","start_unit":2,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"In November-December 2023, the Cyberspace Administration launched a nationwide one-month campaign against online hostility, targeting doxxing, coordinated abuse, fabricated attacks, group stigmatization, violent livestream behavior, malicious reporting, abusive slang, and extreme emotional incitement; it ordered account and group closures, feature restrictions, platform rectification, penalties, and weekly publication of typical cases.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.4","3B.8","3B.9","4B.9","6B.8","8B.2","8B.5","8B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The campaign was launched in November 2023 for one month.","ruler_attribution":"The central cyberspace authority set the campaign, enforcement requirements, platform duties, and reporting expectations.","limitations":["The document records planned enforcement and disclosure requirements but does not provide final enforcement figures or independent evidence of reduced harm."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-110f72cfaa9f5db2","SRC-61ec8543b0f6353c","SRC-87ae050204fc9c19","SRC-126b61e406145c55"],"batch_limitations":["Several sources are official government or state-media documents and may reflect institutional self-presentation.","The supplied evidence is concentrated on official publications, online-content regulation, education spending, and one diplomatic statement; it does not materially cover many nuclear safeguards, military conduct, corruption, judicial independence, electoral contestation, or personal financial integrity lenses.","The SIPRI page supplies budget-table titles but no actual expenditure figures in the supplied units.","The Foreign Ministry page supplied only navigation text and states that the requested page was deleted or unavailable.","The 2025 algorithm-governance document falls outside the target period and was excluded."]}
